card.name: Small numbers and counts in dosing
card.fires_on: Low counting words and digits such as 0, 1, "one" and "×" or "x" after 1, in dose schedules, grades and lists. It also fires on "day" after "every".

modes.label: Digit 0 or 1
modes.description: The digit 0 or 1 at the start of a short list of numbers, a grade, or a fraction.

modes.label: Times sign after 1
modes.description: The × or x between a count and a tablet strength.

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: "one" or "day" in phrases about how often a tablet is taken.
modes.example: One tablet is taken every<< day>>, at the same time.
